zh.question: 同一块电池怎样让灯亮、让车动？用过的能量怎样才能重新储存？
zh.observe: 合上开关，分别试灯丝灯泡、LED 与电机；保留用过的电池进入充电章，对照未接入、不匹配与适配电源。再比较同为 AA 的两种电池，并拉远同一颗电芯查看电池包。

academic.title: 闭合的是完整输运路径
academic.body: 正常放电需要外电路和电芯内部的输运共同配合。金属导线里本来有可移动电子，闭合后电场的变化使各处电荷响应，并不是等电池发出的一颗电子跑完一圈才启动马达。外电路电子的平均运动方向从负极到正极，与约定电流方向相反。断开开关破坏持续导通条件，但不使电池的化学能或导线中的电子消失。

academic.title: 两种载流粒子与化学能
academic.body: 本图采用锂离子电芯放电的例子：负极氧化过程释放电子，正极还原过程接收电子，锂离子经过电解质和多孔隔膜迁移。隔膜减少两极直接接触造成内部短路的风险，同时允许离子输运。可利用化学自由能减少，向外提供电能；电解质中还有其他离子和扩散。其他电池的材料与反应不同，不能照搬所有微观细节。

academic.title: 负载、充电与电池分类
academic.body: 电流通过马达线圈时，线圈在磁场中受力并产生转矩，换向结构帮助维持转动，真实传动系统再带动轮子。能量除机械作用外也转为热。可充电电池必须由适配充电器提供外部能量，推动设计允许的反应向回进行，且循环并不完全无损。一次电池不为反复充电设计，外形相同不能作为可充电的证据。 灯丝因受热发光；LED 通过半导体中的发光过程将部分电能转为光，仍有热损耗，并需要合适的驱动与限流。外形、化学体系与用途是不同分类维度。相同电芯理想串联累加电压，并联累加安时容量；瓦时考虑两者，不能只按安时跨电压比较能量。

zh.misconception: 电池不是装满电子、用完就变空的罐子。电子是电荷载体；放电改变的是材料的化学状态。开关断开与电池耗尽也是两种不同情况。
zh.boundary: 这是正常低压玩具回路的定性模型。粒子尺寸、速度、转角、能量条和热分配为教学选择，不表示真实电量或效率；忽略内阻、反电动势、开关瞬态与自放电。只示意锂离子净迁移。拖动回放、重置屏幕不是实际充电，剖面也不是拆电池的操作指导。 充放电账本采用归一化能量和人为分配比例，不对应产品参数；充电明确计入外部做功及热损耗。电池家族分别适配画幅，不是等尺寸或容量比较；电池包只有最多16颗理想教学电芯，标称电压不是充电设定。

narration.label: 先找开关的小缺口
narration.text: 小玩具里装着电池，轮子就一定会转吗？看一看，导线连着电池、开关和马达，可是开关这里还有一个小缺口。路没有接完整，电池就不能这样一直给玩具供电。先在屏幕上合上开关，再点运行。我们只按屏幕按钮，真实的电池交给大人保管。
narration.cue: 初始开路画面，指向开关缺口；闭合完成后点击运行一次。

narration.label: 外面和里面，各走各的路
narration.text: 现在蓝色小点动起来啦。它们代表导线里的电子。再看看电池的放大图：金色带加号的小点走的是里面的路，它们叫锂离子。两种小伙伴不是同一种东西。电池里的材料发生化学变化，把能量交出来；并不是把一罐蓝色小点倒进马达里，倒完就没有了。
narration.cue: 运行到约30%，保留主回路参照并观察电芯内部；分别指向蓝色电子和金色锂离子。

narration.label: 停一下，看看发生什么
narration.text: 先猜猜看，如果现在打开开关，轮子还会一直转吗？点一下，留一点时间自己看看。蓝点不再继续前进，能量条也停住了，轮子也停下来了。电池里剩下的能量并没有一下子消失。再把开关合上，我们还能接着观察，刚才用过的那一段也没有被忘掉。
narration.cue: 在运行中断开，留出观察停顿；确认进度与能量保持，再重新闭合。

narration.label: 重新储能，再认识电池家族
narration.text: 刚才用过的电池还在。去充电这一站看看：没有外部能源，能量不会自己回来；设备不匹配，也不能接通。适配的充电器送来能量，电池重新储存一部分，另一些变成热。再看两枚长得很像的 AA 电池，它们里面的材料可能不同，能不能充电也不同。汽车的大电池包还需要连接、监测和散热。真实电池都交给大人，我们只在屏幕上探索。
narration.cue: 用过电池后进入充电章，比较三种供电条件；打开家族看碱性与镍氢 AA，再查看电池包的三个职责层。

en.question: How can the same battery power light and motion? What is needed to store energy again?
en.observe: Close the switch and try a filament bulb, LED and motor. Keep the used battery, enter charging and compare absent, incompatible and compatible supplies. Compare two AA chemistries, then zoom from one cell to its pack.

academic.title: A complete transport path
academic.body: Normal discharge requires transport through both the external circuit and the cell. Metal wires already contain mobile electrons. On closure, changing electric fields cause charges around the circuit to respond; the motor need not wait for one electron to finish a lap. Average external electron motion is from negative to positive, opposite conventional current. Opening the switch prevents a sustained conducting path without making stored chemical energy or electrons disappear.

academic.title: Two charge carriers and chemical energy
academic.body: This example follows lithium-ion discharge: oxidation at the negative electrode supplies electrons, reduction at the positive electrode accepts them, and lithium ions move through electrolyte and a porous separator. The separator reduces direct contact between electrodes while permitting ionic transport. Available chemical free energy decreases as electrical energy is supplied externally. Other ions and diffusion also contribute in the electrolyte. Different battery chemistries must not be assumed to share every microscopic detail shown here.

academic.title: Loads, charging and battery classification
academic.body: A current-carrying motor coil experiences magnetic forces that produce torque. Commutation helps sustain rotation, and a real transmission drives the wheels. Energy also becomes heat. A compatible charger supplies external energy to drive the designed reversible reactions back in a rechargeable cell, and cycling is not lossless. Primary cells are not designed for repeated recharging; a similar shape is not evidence that a cell is rechargeable. A heated filament emits light; an LED emits through semiconductor processes, still loses energy as heat, and needs suitable driving and current limiting. Form, chemistry and use are different classification dimensions. Ideal identical cells in series add voltage; parallel branches add amp-hour capacity. Watt-hours account for both, so amp-hours alone cannot compare energy at different voltages.

en.misconception: A battery is not a jar of electrons that becomes empty. Electrons carry charge; discharge changes the chemical state of materials. An open switch and a depleted battery are different conditions.
en.boundary: This is a qualitative normal low-voltage toy circuit. Particle size, speed, rotation, energy bars and heat allocation are teaching choices, not charge or efficiency measurements. Internal resistance, back EMF, switching transients and self-discharge are omitted. Only net lithium-ion transport is emphasized. Scrubbing and reset do not physically recharge a cell, and the cutaway is not a disassembly guide. The discharge/charge ledger uses normalized energy and illustrative allocations, not product specifications; charging explicitly includes external work and heat. Family specimens are independently fitted, not true-size or capacity comparisons. The pack has at most 16 ideal teaching cells; nominal voltage is not a charging setting.

narration.label: Find the little switch gap
narration.text: Will a toy always turn just because it has a battery inside? Look at the wire connecting the battery, switch and motor. There is still a little gap at the switch. With that path incomplete, the battery cannot keep supplying the toy this way. Close the switch on the screen, then choose Run. We only use the screen controls. A grown-up looks after real batteries.
narration.cue: Begin with the open circuit, point to the gap, then close it fully before choosing Run once.

narration.label: Different paths outside and inside
narration.text: Now the blue dots are moving. They stand for electrons in the wire. Look closer inside our battery drawing: the gold dots with plus signs follow an inside path. These are called lithium ions. They are different from electrons. Changes in the battery materials provide energy. The battery is not pouring a jar of blue dots into the motor until the jar becomes empty.
narration.cue: Run to about 30%; keep the whole circuit as a reference and point to external blue electrons and internal gold lithium ions.

narration.label: Pause and see what changes
narration.text: Make a guess. If you open the switch now, will the wheels keep turning forever? Try it and take a little time to look. The blue dots stop progressing, the energy bars stop changing, and the wheels stop in this simplified view. The battery’s remaining energy has not suddenly vanished. Close the switch again and we can continue. The part we already used has not been forgotten.
narration.cue: Open the switch during a run and leave an observation pause. Check preserved progress and energy, then close it again.

narration.label: Store energy again, then meet the family
narration.text: We still have the battery we used. Visit charging: without an outside energy source, its energy cannot return by itself, and incompatible equipment must not connect. A suitable charger supplies energy. The battery stores some, while some becomes heat. Two AA batteries can look alike yet contain different materials and have different charging rules. A large vehicle pack also needs connections, monitoring and cooling. Grown-ups handle real batteries; we explore only on screen.
narration.cue: Enter charging with a used battery and compare all three supply conditions. Compare alkaline and NiMH AA specimens, then inspect the pack's three responsibility layers.
